subject: StrataWave payments onboarding — bank setup + remittance sample
messages:
From: Kevin Lee <kevin.lee@stratawave.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@stratawave.com
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier onboarding: bank letter + remit CSV attached

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the onboarding checklist. Attached are the documents you requested so we can get StrataWave set up for ACH and wire remits: StrataWave_BankLetter.pdf, remit_sample.csv, and our completed W-9. A few notes up front: 
- Bank letter is on bank letterhead and includes ABA/Swift plus an account usage note (payments only).
- remit_sample.csv demonstrates the invoice->remit mapping we use: invoice_id, invoice_date, remit_id (alphanumeric), po_reference.
- We prefer ACH for recurring payments; wires only for one-offs.

We completed the PO intake form you sent and used PO prefix STRATA- in the po_reference field. If you need a separate remit tag (Remit-ID) we can include it.

Let me know if you want us to confirm micro-deposit amounts — we can check the account this week.

Best,
Kevin Lee
Head of Finance Operations
StrataWave, Inc.

Attachments: StrataWave_BankLetter.pdf (pdf), remit_sample.csv (csv), W9_StrataWave.pdf (pdf)

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kevin Lee <kevin.lee@stratawave.com>
Cc: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding: bank letter + remit CSV attached

Thanks Kevin — received and reviewed the attachments. Quick checklist / next steps from our side: 
1) Finance will kick a micro-deposit to the account listed in the bank letter this afternoon. Please confirm the exact two micro-deposit amounts when they appear.
2) We will ingest your remit_sample.csv into our PO routing test environment. Can you confirm whether the remit_id column is unique per invoice (yes/no)?
3) Please confirm the desired remit tag if you want a custom Remit-ID (max 16 chars). Otherwise we'll use STRATA as the remit prefix.

Jonas — looping you in to pick up the ingestion tests and to align on PO-field mapping. Priyom — can you prepare the audit evidence folder (SOC2 scoping) and add the bank letter + W-9 so we have everything for vendor record?

Marissa —

Confirmed: remit_id is unique per invoice (we generate a UUID per invoice). Remit tag: please use STRATA-09 as the Remit-ID prefix.

We checked the account and saw two small micro-deposit test amounts this morning: $0.09 and $0.37 (both originating from Redwood Inference). That matches what our treasury system recorded.

If you need screenshots or a bank statement excerpt as proof of the amounts, I can attach one.

Thanks —
Kevin

Great — thanks for the quick verification, Kevin.

Action items I've completed/assigned: 
- Test environment ingest of remit_sample.csv completed; mapping validated against our PO schema. po_reference -> order_reference (keeps STRATA- prefix), remit_id -> external_remit_id.
- Production push scheduled for Fri 2027-11-05 01:00 UTC (low-traffic window).
- Priyom: please add the bank letter and W-9 to the vendor audit archive and tag as STRATA-09. Also capture a short note that micro-deposit amounts were confirmed $0.09 / $0.37 (evidence: Kevin provided confirmation).

Kevin — once production is live we'll route the first invoice payments through ACH. Expect a confirmation email with the live remit trace and the payment trace id (format: RW-YYYYMMDD-XXXXX).

Thanks everyone — nice and tidy onboarding.

Jonas Weber
Senior Payments Engineer
Redwood Inference
